y-m-63-10.goal: Njengoko itheyibhile nolwazi ngokunyuka nokwehla komsebenzi wekyubhiki zinikwa inyathelo ngenyathelo, hlaziya umgwebo wakho wenani leengcambu zokwenyani ezahlukeneyo ze-f(x)=k, uze ubhale inani ngokwesithuba se-k, kubandakanywa amaxabiso omda.

Kumsebenzi f(x)=x³−6x²+9x kunye nenani lokwenyani k, fumana inani leengcambu zokwenyani ezahlukeneyo zolingano f(x)=k (amanani okwenyani ahlukeneyo x anelisa ulingano) ngokuxhomekeke kwixabiso le-k. (Funda 'x ikyubhi ukuncitshiswa nge-6 x isikwere ukongeza i-9x'.) Ngezantsi yi-f(x) kwi-x eliyinani eliphelele.

f(x) | 0 | 4 | 2 | 0 | 4

y-m-63-07.material:
Kukho ijika y=x² nechaphazelo P(1, −3). (Funda 'y yi-x isikwere'.) Xa x=1, ixabiso le-y lejika li-1, ngoko ichaphazelo P asilichaphazelo elisejikeni. UNara wasombulula ngolu hlobo.

Umgca othe tyaba ngumgca odlula kwichaphazelo elisejikeni (ichaphazelo lokuchukumisa) yaye une-derivative kuloo ndawo njengomthambeka wawo.

y-m-63-01.title: Umda oqikelelwe kwitheyibhile: singawuthemba kangakanani?
y-m-63-01.topic: Imida yemisebenzi: imida yasekhohlo nasekunene, nomahluko phakathi kwexabiso lomda nexabiso lomsebenzi

y-m-63-01.material: Umsebenzi f uchazwa njenge-f(x)=(x²−4)/(x−2) xa x≠2. (Funda 'x isikwere ukususa 4' ihlulwe 'x ukususa 2'.) Ixabiso kwi-x=2 alinikwanga ekuqaleni. y-m-63-03.goal: Qinisekisa ngokuzakhela ukuba zikho izibini ezininzi zemilinganiselo engatshintshiyo eyenza umsebenzi ochazwe ngokwamacandelo uqhubeke kwi-x=1, uze ugwebe ukuba kutshintsha ntoni xa kongezwa imeko yokwahlulwa.
y-m-63-03.material:
"Kwimilinganiselo engatshintshiyo a no-b, chaza umsebenzi f ngolu hlobo.
Kwi-x<1, f(x)=x²+ax
Kwi-x≥1, f(x)=3x+b
(x² ifundwa 'x isikwere'.) Masifumane (a, b) eyenza lo msebenzi uqhubeke kwi-x=1."

y-m-63-03.s.s1.r.b: Oku kukucinga okuguqulele inkcazelo yokuqhubeka ngokuchanekileyo njengokuvumelana kwemida yamacala omabini nexabiso lomsebenzi.

y-m-63-03.s.s1.r.c: Oku kukucinga okubhidanise imeko yokwahlulwa nemeko yokuqhubeka.

y-m-63-03.s.s1.o.e: Amaxabiso 1+a no-3+b, afunyenwe ngokufaka x=1 kwiintetho ezimbini, ayalingana.

Jonga imisebenzi emibini f(x)=|x−1| (ixabiso eliphelele) kunye g(x)=(x−1)² kwi-x=1. UJihye wathi, 'Ukuba umsebenzi uqhubeka kwi-x=1, ngoko lo msebenzi uyahluka kwi-x=1.'
